unit: Frozen case snapshot at a daily cutoff; ID is opaque to the reviewer

fields.review_unit_id: Committed opaque identifier; no model/arm information
fields.source_evidence_refs: References to source evidence available at cutoff
fields.condition_present: true / false / null if not determinable
fields.actionable: true / false / null if not determinable; not a fraud label
fields.missing_evidence: List of documents or fields still required
fields.review_minutes: Measured active review time, not a synthetic estimate
fields.primary_reviewer_id: Accountant independent of development and model selection
fields.blind_to_arm_and_prediction: true only if the reviewer has not seen arm/rank/model output
